title: Mary Skelter raw technical text record
description: One text field extracted from a Mary Skelter 2 / Mary Skelter Finale resource. Technical provenance only: no translation, no semantic alignment. 'text' is the editable field; 'raw_hex' is the ground truth of the source bytes.

source_dataset.description: MS2_PC_LOCALIZED | MS2_SWITCH_JP | MSF_PC_JP | MSF_PC_LOCALIZED | MSF_PC_KO | MSF_PC_SYSTEM

language.description: Mechanically determined: ja | en | ko | zh, or null when the resource carries no language evidence

text.description: Decoded text (editable). Decoded with surrogateescape so it round-trips exactly.

raw_hex.description: Original encoded bytes of the field, without the NUL terminator. Ground truth for no-op validation.

control_metadata.description: Format-level control data needed to interpret the field (endian, message size, descriptor count, flags, ...).

repack_metadata.description: Everything the rebuild needs: blob_type (gnl | enc_row | bin_string), blob_offset / row / string_index, struct_offset, table_offset, field_kind.
